trades.title: Will McDonald's report Above 2.5% global comparable sales growth in Q2 2026?
trades.rationale: Q1 2026 global comps 3.8% (US 3.9%, IOM 3.9%). Q2 threshold 2.5% — needs 1.3-point deceleration to miss. Revenue growth 9.4%, FCF strong. Warning: stock -4.9% in 20d, below both MAs. Adjusted from 63% to 58% on stock weakness signal.

trades.title: Best AI in Dec 2026? — Claude: Anthropic
trades.rationale: Market prices Claude at 64% to win best AI by Dec 2026. AI landscape is fragmented — Claude leads coding, Gemini leads reasoning, GPT leads agentic tasks. 7 months is an eternity in AI. Estimate 45% — market overconfident in single-model dominance.

trades.title: Best AI in Dec 2026? — Gemini: Google
trades.rationale: Gemini 3.1 Pro leads hardest reasoning benchmarks (GPQA Diamond 94.3%, ARC-AGI-2 77.1%) at lowest major-lab price. If best AI weights reasoning, Gemini has a strong case. Market at 16% feels too low.

trades.title: Best AI in Dec 2026? — ChatGPT: OpenAI
trades.rationale: GPT-5.4 is the best all-rounder with the largest ecosystem. If best AI uses a composite or user preference metric, OpenAI has a strong argument. Market at 14% seems too low. Third leg of Claude-NO / Gemini-YES / GPT-YES position — hits 3-trade correlation cap on best-AI concept.

trades.title: When will SpaceX IPO? — Before Jul 1, 2026
trades.rationale: SpaceX S-1 confirmed filed May 20. Roadshow June 8, pricing June 18-30, first trade late June. Market at 98% YES (IPO before Jul 1). Execution risk: pricing of June 28-30 could push first trading day to July 1+. Largest IPO in history adds complexity. Musk comments diverged from filing per CNBC. Estimate 88% YES — buying NO at 3c as a low-cost timing-risk hedge.
